notes: Manual Case fixture (WorkRequest NW-WP-02 §8.1): a human-authored case loaded into the library to demonstrate incremental preservation — regeneration after a spec change must never silently delete it. All data is synthetic.

case.title: Manual smoke: read one widget with a fixed synthetic id
preconditions: Demo API test environment is reachable
The synthetic widget id may or may not exist; both outcomes are acceptable for this smoke check

assumptions.statement: A read of a possibly-missing widget id returns either 200 or 404 without side effects.
assumptions.rule: manual judgement confirmed by the reviewer
